Overlay queue

    Layers from the top: 5 prompts, 4 media feedback, 3 main menu, 2 page; all can be on screen at once. D-pad: the prompt gets it first, then the open menu, then the page. Prompts: a higher level replaces the one on screen and the replaced one goes to the queue; an equal or lower level is queued after the last prompt of the same or a higher level; closing a prompt brings up the first one in the queue; a prompt that is already on screen or queued is ignored. Feedback replaces the current feedback immediately and closes after 3 s; it never touches the menu timer, and the menu timer is paused while a prompt is on screen.

    Try: "Text + call at once" (the call is on screen, the text is queued), "Text, then low fuel" (low fuel replaces the text, which waits in the queue), "Low tyre + critical fuel" (same level: the first stays on screen), or open the menu with Page, press a volume key, then trigger a prompt. Pressing "Text received" again while it is on screen or queued does nothing. Directions and trip information turn guidanceIsActive on and open the Navigation page. Locked Settings turns vehicleIsMoving on and opens Settings. Alert prompts stay pressed while their condition is active, even after the rider dismisses them.

    Text field test hook: in the browser console, hmiSet("odometer", "longest") forces the longest string of a field and brings it on screen, hmiCheck("odometer") reports clipping or wrapping, hmiCheckAll() runs every field, hmiReset() clears it. hmiFields() lists the fields with their format, range, step, no-data text and longest string.
